class.name: InputScale
class.brief_description: Multiplies a binding's components by independent gains.
class.description: Use on Axis, Vector, and Motion bindings. A gain below one reduces the magnitude of that component. Zero removes it and a negative gain flips its sign. An Axis action uses X. The gains are dimensionless and must be finite.

members.member: Multipliers for the incoming X and Y values. Set both to one to preserve the original magnitude.
